events.title: Paraguay: Senate removes President Santiago Peña over the ueno bank affair; Peña placed under house arrest; Vice-President Pedro Alliana sworn in
lists: reuters (as cited in the Wikipedia entry; Reuters page not read)
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file (prepared 4 Nov 19:02 UTC). The Senate removal had no date before planning closed: the Chamber voted to open the trial on the evening of 5 Nov. The lead-up was visible (Senators announced a trial request on 3 Nov; the 2026-11-06 coverage file already logged Peña's resignation as missed). Same gap as the 6 Nov entry: Reuters/AP Latin America headlines were not swept on 3-4 Nov. No dated announcement, so not a new sweep gap.

events.title: Kenya: Shakahola cult leader Paul Mackenzie sentenced to 200 years for the murder of 190 children and one adult
lists: reuters (as cited in the Wikipedia entry; Reuters page not read)
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file. Announced in advance: after the conviction on 19-20 Oct the Mombasa High Court scheduled its sentencing decision for 6 Nov, and the ODPP published its sentencing submissions (death penalty sought) on 3 Nov (The Kenya Times, 3-4 Nov: https://thekenyatimes.com/latest-kenya-times-news/pastor-mackenzie-penalty/). We should have seen it in a world court calendar; none for Kenya is in pipeline/sources.json. Sweep gap. Note the planning file excluded crime stories (cut of the French blood-bank cyber-attack), but a scheduled sentencing with a numeric outcome is a forecastable court event.

events.title: Thomas Markle, father of the Duchess of Sussex, arrested by the FBI in Florida over child sexual abuse material
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file. Not announced in advance (an arrest); no sweep gap. Crime story, outside the paper's usual remit.

events.title: Trump: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles leaves, Stephen Miller to replace her
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file. Not announced in advance (Trump denied in mid-October that he would replace Wiles); announced late on 6 Nov (ctk 22:28). No sweep gap. Not yet in the Wikipedia day page as read.

events.title: European Commission preliminarily finds TikTok in breach of the DSA over its 'For You' recommender ('rabbit holes')
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file. Not announced in advance: the Commission does not pre-date preliminary DSA findings (the TikTok proceedings were open, but no step was scheduled). No sweep gap.

events.title: Finance Ministry and ČNB worsen outlooks: 2026 general government deficit 2.8% of GDP (MF: 3.5% in 2027), 2026 growth cut to 1.7%
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file (its 'deficit' mentions are only the trade balance). Announced in advance as a regular release: the MF November Macroeconomic Forecast and Fiscal Outlook are a fixed quarterly publication, and the ČNB forecast followed the 5 Nov board meeting (ČNB monetary-policy page is in sources.json; MF is not). I did not verify that MF published the exact date beforehand. Treated as a sweep gap: the MF publication schedule is missing from pipeline/sources.json.
